posts.text: I find all “the senate is the problem because it’s undemocratic” discourse to be ridiculous on many philosophical, factual, and political levels. But the biggest reason it’s ridiculous is it’s just a waste of time. The Constitution literally makes it impossible to get rid of the senate, so maybe just deal with its existence the way we have to deal with the moon. Neither are going anywhere in our lifetimes.
